item.title: Notify NYC - Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert
item.description:
Alert issued 10-22-2026 at 09:44 AM.
A Missing Vulnerable Adult Alert has been issued for Esperanza Soto, a 84-year-old white female from Flushing, NY. The missing may be in need of medical attention.
Description: 5'5" tall, 110lbs, with gray hair and brown eyes. Wearing a black coat, grey sweatpants, blue sneakers, black bag and a blue medical mask.
Last Seen: 71st Avenue in Flushing, NY at approximately 11:30 AM on 10-21-2026.
Vehicle: Black 2015 Chevrolet SUV with NY license plate number MDZ-5953.
If you see the missing person, please call the NYPD Missing Person Squad at (800) 577-8477 or call 9-1-1.
A photo of the missing is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sHEMyq
